Easy care in everyday life

In case of dust, you can easily clean it with a vacuum cleaner; in the case of stains, wipe carefully only with a damp cloth - no time-consuming cleaning necessary.

Versatile applications, cost-effective choice

The compact sofa is suitable for almost any room and situation. Whether as a main seat in the living room, as a guest sofa in the guest room, as a work sofa in the home office or as an additional seating area for parties - it adapts flexibly. 3 Stromversorgungsmethoden: Sind Sie immer noch wütend, dass Ihre elektronische Laterne spät in der Nacht draußen ausgeschaltet ist? Es kann auch als Notstrombank verwendet werden, wodurch Ihr iPhone vorübergehend geladen werden können. Du wirst niemals Angst haben, draußen isoliert zu sein.

Ultra Bright und Super Long Standby: Unsere Solarlaterne ist mit 200 Lumen hell genug. Die eingebauten wiederaufladbaren Batterien haben eine super lange Lebensdauer. Machen Sie sich keine Mühe, die Batterie häufig zu ersetzen, was wirtschaftlich und umweltfreundlich ist. Stecken Sie den Adapter (5v / 2A) in einen Standardstecker an und schließen Sie dann den Steckdose "micro USB-Schnittstelle" auf der Breite an, um den Akku aufzuladen. Wenn der Akku voll geladen ist, kann das Hauptlicht nicht weniger als 35 Stunden lang kontinuierlich eingeschaltet sein.

Einzigartiges zusammenklappbares Design und einfach zu bedienen: Unsere Laterne wird durch die zusammenklappbare Struktur gesteuert, mit der Sie die Helligkeit ändern können, indem Sie die Höhe der Laterne einstellen. Sie können den oberen Teil nach oben ziehen oder nach unten schieben, um die Laterne an oder aus zu halten, sehr einfach zu bedienen. Nach dem Falten kann das Unterlicht nach Drücken des mittleren Knopfes auch als Taschenlampe verwendet werden. Die Griffe werden verwendet, um die Laterne an einem Baum oder einem Zelt zu hängen, um Ihre Umgebung zu beleuchten.

Die Größe beträgt 10,6 * 7,4 * 3,19 Zoll. Gewicht: 300g. Mit süßem Design und schicker Farbe werden Sie es auf jeden Fall lieben.

Leicht und tragbar: Unsere Handkurbellanterne hat ein überlegenes zusammenklappbares Design, wodurch sie einfach gefaltet und gelagert wird. Leicht und kompakt, können Sie es in Ihren Rucksack, große Tasche oder Notfallkit setzen, ideal für Outdoor-Aktivitäten, Wandern, Camping, Angeln, Autowartung oder Ausschalten.

products.title: Fake Two Leopard Print Lapel V-neck Pockets Loose Mid Length Hoodie Dresses
products.body_html:
Fake two leopard print lapel V-neck pockets loose mid length hoodie dresses
Style positioning
Maillard retro spicy girl style, fake two piece layered lazy dress, preferred for daily use, store exploration, and street photography
Suitable season: Spring and Autumn main promotion, thick looped hoodie fabric, can be worn with leggings and boots in early winter
Applicable scenarios: city shopping, coffee shop exploration, American retro street photography, campus leisure, short distance travel
Fabric Analysis
The outer layer of pure color washed looped hoodie fabric is soft, smooth, and not prone to pilling; Splicing inner leopard print chiffon shirt material, lightweight and crisp with clear printing, not easy to fade or deform; Black and brown leopard print contrasting colors create a strong retro atmosphere.
Cutting design highlights
Double layered fake two piece lapel V-neck structure
The outer V-neckline of the hoodie features a complete leopard print lapel shirt layer. The lapel, cuffs, and hem are simultaneously exposed with leopard print stitching, eliminating the need for extra layering and providing a layered layering effect.

Loose shoulder extended lantern sleeves
Wide cut off shoulder sleeves, with the cuffs turned out to reveal leopard print lining, covering the flesh of the arms and not pressing down on the shoulders. It can be used to decorate both sloping and wide shoulders.
Front kangaroo large patch bag
The symmetrical kangaroo pocket in the middle of the garment can be used to hold items, weaken the abdominal line, and hide excess fat in the lower abdomen.
Split mid length curved hem
The length of the garment covers the hips, with a small side slit design and a leopard print skirt lining exposed at the hem, creating a missing effect on the lower garment and elongating the leg proportions vertically.

Features:

1. Solar Powered, Install Anywhere, 100% Wireless: Outdoor Triple Lens Security Camera: equipped with an 8W high-efficiency monocrystalline solar panel. Under the same light, they convert light to electricity with a 93% conversion rate (twice that of ordinary panels) and fully charge in 8 hours. Just place it in direct sunlight to charge! No more worries about dead batteries or messy wires. 

 

2. 8000mAh Built-in Batteries: The solar panel keeps charging under direct sun, and the built-in rechargeable battery ensures non-stop monitoring in bad weather or low light—set it and forget it!

 

3. Three Cameras In One, 360° view: one body equipped with three cameras: the central camera can rotate horizontally from 0 to 270° and vertically from 0 to 90°. The two side cameras support manual horizontal adjustment of up to 180° and vertical adjustment of up to 180°. This versatile 3-in-1 camera delivers 9MP High Resolution video quality and provides a complete 360° view, ensuring full coverage with no blind spots.

 

4. Vivid Night Vision & Interactive Audio: This exterior PTZ camera, complete with infrared and warm light LEDs, offers color/IR night vision capabilities up to 60 feet. It maintains clear imaging even in pitch-black environments through its full-color night vision. The camera provides three different night vision modes for your selection. With its dual-lens design, it also includes a built-in speaker and microphone, enabling real-time interaction with visitors or the deterrence of intruders via the mobile app, from anywhere.

5. Stronger deterrent for intruders: The camera is equipped with a waming light that can emit red and blue lights. This will have a more powerful deterent effect when detecting intruders

 

6. AI Human Detection, Auto Tracking & Guard Point: This Wi-Fi-enabled PTZ security camera features an integrated AI algorithm that triggers upon sensing human motion, efficiently avoiding false alarms from non-human movements like leaves or insects. When it detects a person, the camera automatically follows the movement and sends alerts to your mobile device. After the detected individual leaves the camera's range, it automatically returns to its preset Guard Position.

 

7. 24/7 Cloud And SD Card Storage & Multi-Device Sharing: This Triple-lens PTZ camera for outdoor home security offers 24/7 surveillance with footage storage options. You can choose between secure cloud storage (with a complimentary 30-day trial) or a local SD card (Support TF Card 32GB-256GB, not included). 

 

8. Waterproof And Durable Outdoor Camera: This camera is designed to withstand splashes, water, high temperatures, and cold, with an IP66 waterproof rating. It operates in a wide temperature range of -30 to 140℉, making it a reliable Wi-Fi security camera for all weather conditions.

These disposable PE dust-proof covers are versatile transparent plastic sleeves mainly designed for suitcase universal wheels, effectively shielding luggage casters from dirt, sand, mud, scratches and abrasion during travel, transit and storage to keep wheels clean and intact.

Made of lightweight flexible polyethylene material, they are thin, stretchable, easy to slip on and take off in seconds without extra tools. Besides covering luggage wheels, they serve multiple household purposes: wrapping table and chair legs to prevent floor scuffs, covering office chair casters, acting as disposable ear covers, makeup sponge storage bags and small item dust wraps.
